scope: developmental replication on previously exposed 331-graph identity retrieval panel; NOT independent binding validation
historical_exposure: 0.7666/0.7944 and shortcut/stratified diagnostics known before protocol
architecture: 6-layer hidden128 invariant EGNN; unchanged historical v2 recipe, corrected edges/seeds; head385->256->128
epoch_selection: fixed final epoch120 only; no tuning, checkpoint selection, early stopping or best-seed selection
validation_policy: No parameter search. Original 5 historically exposed family folds used for descriptive out-of-fold queries. Actual independent measured acceptance sets remain unopened.
gallery: all331 graphs excluding query, historical transductive-gallery identity retrieval; positive identity matches may be in held-out fold

primary.metric: family-equal mean of per-query AUROC(model)-AUROC(composition), same-family negative restriction, seed-averaged within query
primary.eligible: all same-receptor positives retained, only same-family different-receptor negatives; both classes required; undefined counts reported
primary.expected_available_from_metadata: 62 queries, 11 families; not an independent 331-sample test
primary.evidence_rule: conditional family-cluster CI lower>0; each of3 seed family-mean deltas>0; true-minus-shuffled same-family CI lower>0
primary.practical_claim: no biological or practical significance claim; no justified application-level margin exists

secondary: per-fold pooled AUROC and rank1; no cross-fold pooled scoring
per-seed effect sizes, no dropping collapsed seeds

uncertainty.unit: family; equal-family estimand after seed averaging within query
uncertainty.scope: conditional on cached trained models and fixed gallery; family groups do not ensure source independence; not full model-population uncertainty

shuffle.unit: joint(receptor_id,family_id) tuple permuted across training graph positions only; graph features and original evaluation labels unchanged
shuffle.preserved: training graph positions, fold boundaries, class counts, family counts and class-family mapping; mini-batch positive patterns may change
shuffle.seed: local NumPy RNG base20261023 +1000003*fold + initialization seed
shuffle.interpretation: 3 label permutations per fold: descriptive negative control, not calibrated permutation p-value; no permutation selection

determinism.replay: full fold0 seed20261021 repeated once; exact state tensor and embedding equality required

failure_policy: Stop on nonfinite loss/gradient or failed binding/replay; retain logs and partial files. Any recipe/data/source changes require explicit new frozen amendment before rerun. No shortening epochs after inspecting results.
protection: Exclusive flock prevents duplicate runner. No SPR/MIRA/clinical/reserved acceptance dataset paths are read.
